London South Bank University Scholarships can reduce tuition fees for eligible international students through merit awards, subject-based discounts and progression routes. LSBU's main published international awards are worth £2,000 to £5,000, but the amount, duration and eligibility depend on the scholarship.

London South Bank University Scholarships at a Glance

LSBU says it has committed over £1 million to its international scholarship scheme. Most awards take the form of a tuition fee reduction, not a payment towards rent or everyday expenses.

These figures come from LSBU's published international scholarship conditions. They do not guarantee the same awards for every 2027 entry period. The university also restricts students from accepting more than one of its applicable international awards. Do not add discounts together when estimating your fees.

LSBU Scholarships for International Students: Who Qualifies?

The general international schemes may be relevant to applicants from Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Nigeria and other countries, provided they meet LSBU's conditions. Some £5,000 awards, however, are restricted to students from eligible European countries or recognised educational partners.

LSBU scholarship eligibility usually depends on international fee status, course level, academic qualifications, offer conditions and previous institution. A student who has excellent grades may qualify for a merit award but not a partner award. Equally, an eligible pathway student might receive a larger first-year discount without meeting the separate merit-award benchmark.

Here's the thing: a scholarship's headline value tells you very little until you check whether it applies once or every year. For a three-year degree, that difference can be substantial.

Global Success Scholarship: Amounts by Subject

The Global Success Scholarship is available to eligible international undergraduate and postgraduate students. It reduces tuition fees in the first year only, and the amount varies by academic school.

LSBU sets out these figures in its subject-specific scholarship schedule.

For example, an eligible postgraduate student joining a Business programme could receive £4,000 off first-year tuition, while an undergraduate in the same school could receive £3,500. A qualifying Arts and Social Sciences student would receive £2,000 at either level. The amount is determined by the published school category, not simply by the student's nationality.

Eligibility and deposit conditions

Applicants must hold an eligible LSBU offer, meet its conditions and pay any required early deposit by the applicable deadline. LSBU's general scholarship information refers to a £2,000 tuition fee deposit within four weeks of meeting all offer conditions. Your individual offer and intake instructions take precedence when confirming dates or payments.

The award is not an automatic £4,000 reduction for every postgraduate programme. First confirm which school offers your intended course. You can compare the subjects and degree routes available at LSBU before matching your course to the table.

Vice-Chancellor's International Merit Award

The Vice-Chancellor's International Merit Award recognises academically strong international undergraduate applicants. Its published value is £2,000 for each academic year, subject to the scholarship's ongoing conditions.

LSBU describes the standard as grades equivalent to AAB or above at UK A-level, approximately 75% or higher in certain international school-leaving qualifications. The university decides whether a qualification from another education system meets that benchmark.

Consider an applicant with 78% in a national school-leaving examination. That result may be promising, but it does not automatically establish AAB equivalency. The qualification, grading system and offer conditions still matter.

The merit award is subject to restrictions on combining LSBU discounts. It is not listed as the equivalent standard award for postgraduate taught students. Master's applicants should first check the Global Success and other eligible schemes. LSBU explains the published academic threshold and award terms.

Other £5,000 LSBU Scholarships

Four additional schemes have a published £5,000 tuition fee discount, but their eligibility and duration are different. They should not be treated as interchangeable awards.

European Impact Scholarship

The European Impact Scholarship offers £5,000 per academic year throughout an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate taught course. Applicants generally need to be new, self-funded international fee-paying students from an eligible European country, with a recognised European pre-university qualification.

The scheme excludes research degrees, short courses and certain other non-standard programmes. LSBU also excludes EU students living in the UK with pre-settled status from this particular award. Eligible students do not need a separate scholarship application; LSBU says the discount is awarded automatically. Check the eligible countries and scheme restrictions.

Transnational Education (TNE) Partner Award

The TNE Partner Award, also called the LSBU Global Partner Scholarship, provides £5,000 per academic year to eligible students progressing from recognised LSBU global partner institutions.

Applicants must normally have completed their most recent qualification at an approved TNE partner within the previous two years and be entering a standard full-time undergraduate or postgraduate taught programme as a new self-funded international fee-paying student. LSBU says the discount is applied automatically at the point of offer.

An overseas college is not necessarily an LSBU partner. The recognised-partner eligibility conditions are the deciding factor.

Cambridge Education Group (CEG) Progression Award

The CEG Progression Award offers £5,000 off first-year tuition to eligible students moving directly from an LSBU pathway delivered by Cambridge Education Group into an undergraduate or postgraduate taught course.

Students must meet the required progression and enrolment conditions. LSBU sets additional progression and enrolment requirements, which applicants should check directly with the university. The award is not a recurring £5,000 discount. LSBU describes it as automatically awarded to eligible students under the CEG pathway conditions.

LSBU Pathway Progression Scholarship

The LSBU Pathway Progression Scholarship also provides £5,000 in the first year, but it covers a wider set of approved pathway and articulation routes.

Eligible routes may include recognised Ofqual-regulated Level 3 Foundation qualifications and approved Level 4 International Year One programmes. LSBU names providers including NCUK, NCC Education, Study Group, INTO Study, Kaplan International Pathways and Oxford International Education Group. Approval still depends on the specific programme; International Year One progression requires academic mapping and course-level approval.

Applicants generally must have completed the relevant qualification within the previous two years and enter a standard full-time undergraduate or postgraduate taught programme. The scheme does not cover postgraduate research, part-time courses or other excluded routes. Refer to LSBU's progression eligibility details rather than assuming every pathway qualifies.

Undergraduate vs Postgraduate Scholarships at LSBU

Undergraduate applicants may be eligible for the annual Vice-Chancellor's Merit Award, a first-year Global Success discount or the applicable European and partner awards. Postgraduate taught applicants can consider Global Success, European Impact and qualifying progression routes, but should not assume that the undergraduate merit award also applies to a master's degree.

Duration deserves particular attention. An eligible undergraduate receiving a £2,000 annual merit discount over three academic years could see £6,000 in total reductions, provided every year's conditions are met. That may exceed the £3,500 first-year Global Success award available in certain subjects. The two discounts should not be combined.

Research students need a different route altogether.

LSBU Bursaries and Hardship Support

Students searching for an LSBU bursary, LSBU bursaries or an LSBU hardship fund should distinguish those schemes from international entry scholarships.

LSBU publishes a £1,000 annual Care Leaver Bursary and a £1,000 annual Estranged Students Bursary for eligible undergraduates under 25, alongside other targeted support. It also describes a discretionary Student Support Fund for eligible enrolled students facing financial difficulty. These schemes have separate personal and enrolment criteria; they are not general £1,000 awards for every international applicant.

The university's student bursary information explains the relevant restrictions. Applicants should not treat an LSBU bursary or hardship payment as interchangeable with Global Success or another international tuition scholarship.

How to Apply for London South Bank University Scholarships

Most applicants should begin with an eligible university course application. There is no universal separate scholarship form for all six awards.

  1. Choose your course and entry period. Check the qualification level, academic school and current course requirements.
  2. Match your eligibility. Review academic grades, international fee status, nationality where relevant and any recognised progression institution.
  3. Submit your university application. Use the appropriate LSBU or UCAS route and provide the academic and English language documents required for your course.
  4. Check your offer and deadlines. Where an award requires an early deposit or acceptance, follow the specific conditions and payment instructions LSBU sends you.
  5. Confirm the award. Automatic consideration does not remove eligibility restrictions. Verify the tuition fee discount against your offer or the university's current scholarship correspondence.

LSBU outlines the international university application steps. For an applicant juggling several courses, a simple table of offers, scholarship conditions and deadlines can prevent unnecessary confusion.

Can you get an LSBU scholarship without IELTS?

A scholarship does not waive admission English language requirements. LSBU may accept other approved evidence of English proficiency for a particular course, but applicants must meet the university's published standard. Do not treat “scholarship without IELTS” as proof that an English language qualification is unnecessary.

LSBU Scholarship Deadlines for 2027 Entry

There is no single deadline for every London South Bank University scholarship. Course applications, offer acceptance, deposits and any award-specific procedures can follow different dates.

LSBU has opened applications for selected January 2027 courses, subject to country availability. Its published international admissions information still marks some 2027 regional application and deposit deadlines as TBC, including those for several overseas markets. September 2027 applicants also need to verify the relevant course and scholarship cycle rather than assume that 2026/27 award terms will automatically continue.

A practical detail applicants often miss: the scholarship condition may have an earlier deadline than the course application itself. For planning, separate three questions: Is the course open? Has LSBU confirmed the applicable scholarship? What is the deadline attached to my offer? Only a date published for your own course and entry period should guide your application.

LSBU Tuition Fees, Scholarship Savings and External Awards

LSBU's currently published international fee information lists starting tuition fees of £16,440 for undergraduate programmes and £16,740 for MSc, MA and PgDip programmes. These are starting figures for the university's published fee arrangements, not fixed prices for every course or guaranteed 2027/28 rates. Check the latest programme fee information.

For a simple example, suppose a qualifying postgraduate course costs £20,000 and the student receives a £4,000 first-year Global Success discount. The illustrative remaining tuition fee would be £16,000. This is an example calculation, not a quotation for a particular LSBU course. A tuition discount also does not automatically cover accommodation or living expenses. These additional costs are worth comparing when planning a wider UK university shortlist.

What about external scholarships for international students at LSBU? Independently administered schemes such as Chevening have their own course, nationality, eligibility and application rules. Check the Chevening eligible-course information before assuming a scholarship applies to LSBU. External and LSBU awards are not automatically combinable.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does London South Bank University offer scholarships for international students?

Yes. Its principal published international scholarships include Global Success, the Vice-Chancellor's Merit Award, European Impact and partner progression awards. Eligibility depends on the scheme, degree level, fee status and applicant background.

How much is an LSBU scholarship for international students?

The main published awards range from £2,000 to £5,000. Global Success gives eligible undergraduates £2,000–£3,500 and postgraduates £2,000–£4,000 in the first year. Certain eligible partner and European awards are worth £5,000, sometimes annually.

Are London South Bank University Scholarships available for 2027?

LSBU currently publishes its scholarship schemes, but applicants must confirm availability and conditions for their particular January or September 2027 start. Not every 2027 deadline or 2027/28 award term has been confirmed.

Can Bangladeshi or Indian students apply for LSBU scholarships?

Yes, eligible applicants from Bangladesh and India can be considered for general international awards such as Global Success. Some other scholarships depend on an eligible European country or a recognised partner pathway, so nationality alone does not determine all awards.

Is a £5,000 LSBU scholarship free money?

The published £5,000 awards are tuition fee discounts for students meeting specific conditions, not unrestricted cash grants available to everyone. Some apply only to the first year; others may continue annually.

Do I need a separate scholarship application?

Not always. LSBU describes the European Impact and TNE Partner awards as automatically applied to eligible students, while other awards depend on offer, deposit or pathway conditions. Confirm the procedure for the award relevant to you.

Does LSBU offer fully funded PhD scholarships?

Can I combine two LSBU scholarships?

LSBU restricts students from accepting more than one of its applicable international awards. Do not add two published discounts together; check which one the university confirms for your application.

Conclusion

If you're preparing for a 2027 intake, choose your course first, compare the scholarships you genuinely qualify for and verify any unconfirmed deadlines directly with LSBU. For help comparing courses and understanding university entry requirements, you can discuss your study options with an education counsellor. Scholarship eligibility and awards remain the university's decision.
